data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (weather lookup and 10 Day forecast, BBC "<city> strike" search, mail draft with the "Heads-up" subject, body, then Discard), but it has some problems: it never opens the first BBC result, it splits traveler into separate recipient email and name parameters instead of deriving the email from one traveler value, it lists derived values (forecast, headline) as inputs, and it gives no exact template for the email body.
